navaid.name: Suisun Bay Reserve Fleet
navaid.description: The National Defense Reserve Fleet is designed provide a reserve of ships for national defense and national emergencies, mostly dry cargo ships with a few tankers and military auxiliaries.
Appears to be a derelict barge of some sort, may have floated up the channel a bit in 2023/2024
